# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 10 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Man of God Speaks to Aseneth; She Is Transformed

---

**10:1** The man of God said to her: 'Take courage, Aseneth, and do not be afraid. Stand upright, and I will speak to you.'

**10:2** Aseneth stood on her feet. The man of God said to her: 'Take off the mourning garment and shake the ashes from your head. Wash your face and hands with pure living water, put on a new and undefiled white garment, and bind yourself with a bright shining girdle of virginity.'

**10:3** 'Then come back to me, and I will speak to you words of life.'

**10:4** Aseneth hurried to her inner chamber and put on a new white linen garment and tied a golden girdle about herself, wrapped a gold linen head-covering around her head, and came to the man of God.

**10:5** The man of God said to her: 'Remove the covering from your head, for today you are a holy virgin and your head is like that of a young man.'

**10:6** Aseneth removed the covering from her head.

**10:7** The man of God said to her: 'Take courage, Aseneth. Behold, the Lord God has heard the voice of your confession and has seen the humbling of your heart. You abased yourself before him and submitted under the great wings of the Most High God.'

**10:8** 'And behold, your name has been written in the Book of the Living in heaven, and it will never be erased forever and ever.'

**10:9** 'From this day you will be renewed and remade and given new life. You will eat the blessed bread and drink the cup of immortality and be anointed with the ointment of incorruption.'

**10:10** 'Take courage, Aseneth. Behold, today I will give you to Joseph as a bride. Your name will no longer be called Aseneth, but your name will be City of Refuge, for many nations will take refuge in you, and under your wings many peoples who trust in the Lord God Most High will find shelter.'

**10:11** Aseneth rejoiced greatly at the man's words. She fell at his feet and said: 'Lord, have mercy on me, your handmaid, for I spoke evil and did not know that Joseph is your son.'

**10:12** The man of God said to her: 'Joseph is a son of God and a son of the power of God. This is the mystery of the Most High God, and I cannot speak to you more of this mystery.'

**10:13** The man of God said to Aseneth: 'Have you heard the words of my mouth?'

**10:14** She said: 'Yes, lord, I have heard all the words of your mouth.'

**10:15** The man said to her: 'From now on you will eat the blessed bread of life, drink the cup of immortality, and be anointed with the ointment of incorruption. For from this day your youth will never fail and your beauty will never fade — you will be like a fortified city to all eternity.'

**10:16** Aseneth said to the man of God: 'My lord, sit for a little while, and let me set before you a table with bread, that you may eat; and I will bring you aged and fine wine of pleasant fragrance that you may drink, and then you may go your way.'

**10:17** The man said to her: 'Bring also a honeycomb.' Aseneth was troubled, for there was no honeycomb in her storeroom.

**10:18** The man of God said: 'Go to your inner chamber — you will find a honeycomb there.' Aseneth went in and found a honeycomb lying on the table, large and white as snow, full of honey, its fragrance like the breath of life.

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
